 Order
Date : 30-01-2019 Heard Mr. G Pathak, learned counsel for the accused-petitioner as well as Mr. K Konwar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, appearing for the State respondent.

This is an application, filed under Section 439 of the Cr.PC. seeking bail of the accused-petitioner,
namely, Sri Santanu Kumar Deori, in connection with Noonmati P.S. Case No. 797/2018 registered under Sections 273/284/420 of the IPC read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954.

sentences.text: Page No.# 2/2 Perused the petition as well as the annexures furnished therewith including the forwarding report.
Considering the period of detention of 34 (thirty four) days of the accused- petitioner in custody, his further custodial detention is not considered necessary.
Therefore, the accused-petitioner is granted bail.

Accordingly, the accused-petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail in connection with Noonmati P.S. Case No. 797/2018 on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 5,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (Metro), Guwahati.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
